title: Integration test: multi-device EventSource fanout
description:
What: Integration tests: (1) two EventSource clients on same kithd both receive state push within 500ms of a state change, (2) both see the same new message via Message/changes, (3) reconnect with Last-Event-Id delivers missed events. Use in-process oneshot pattern (no real TCP needed).

Algorithm:
1. Use existing make_full_app(owner_whois) pattern from e2e.rs to build a Router.
2. Get a reference to events_tx from AppState.
3. Test (1) — two clients receive push within 500ms:
   a. Spawn two tokio tasks, each calling app.clone().oneshot(sse_request).await
   b. SSE request: GET /jmap/events with Accept: text/event-stream
   c. In a third task: tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50)).await; then send StateChange via events_tx
   d. Both tasks read from the SSE response body stream, each waiting for 'event: state' line
   e. Assert: both tasks receive the event within 500ms (use tokio::time::timeout)
   f. Parse event data: verify JSON contains state field (independent oracle: state value advances from s-0)

4. Test (2) — Message/changes after EventSource push:
   a. Connect SSE stream as above
   b. Send a JMAP Message/set create to insert a message
   c. Wait for SSE push (state advance)
   d. Call Message/changes with sinceState=s-0
   e. Assert: response contains the newly created message ID in 'created' list

5. Test (3) — Last-Event-Id reconnect:
   a. Send two StateChange events (state s-1, s-2)
   b. Connect SSE stream with Last-Event-Id: s-1
   c. Assert: only s-2 is delivered (s-1 already seen; reconnect delivers only missed events)
   d. This tests the replay-from-id logic already present in events_handler

Defensive programming:
- SSE response body is a stream of bytes; parse 'event: ...' and 'data: ...' lines manually (spec: RFC 8895 §9.2)
- Use tokio::time::timeout on all stream reads to avoid hanging tests
- Independent oracle for state values: track expected counter s-N independently of app state

Agent team: R (read events.rs existing tests to avoid duplication) + I (implement) + T (derive expected SSE lines from RFC 8895 spec) + V (cargo test -p kithd)

Tests: Three tests with independent oracles: state counter, known SSE line format, message ID in changes response
